text.value: Consent re-confirmed for the MoCA-B assessment?
Registration says: "". Enter completed years of schooling (0-30). +1 point is added if < 4 years (capped at 30).
Inability to read or write fluently in daily living. +1 point is added regardless of years of education (capped at 30).
Start time (record before administering Executive Function)

Ask the subject to draw a line alternating between a square with a number and a square with dots in increasing order: 1 -> (1 dot) -> 2 -> (2 dots) -> 3 -> (3 dots) -> 4 -> (4 dots) -> 5 -> (5 dots) -> 6 -> (6 dots). 1 point only if completed on first attempt without any errors or self-corrections.
Trail Making (1 -> 1 dot -> ... -> 6 -> 6 dots, zero errors/self-corrections)
Read the 5 words at 1 word/second. Perform 2 trials even if the 1st trial is successful. No points are scored for Trials 1 and 2.
Words: ROSE, CHAIR, HAND, BLUE, SPOON
Read the same 5 words a second time. Inform the subject that they will be asked to recall these words again at the end of the test.

Ask the subject to name as many FRUITS as possible in 1 minute (60 seconds). Record all words to ensure repeated words are not counted. Scoring: >=13 fruits = 2 pts; 8-12 fruits = 1 pt; <=7 fruits = 0 pts.
List named fruits to track repeats.
Total unique FRUITS named in 1 minute (N)
Without looking at a watch, ask approximate time (within +/- 2 hours accepted). Then ask day of the week, month, year, name of this place (hospital/clinic/office), and city.

Provide ways to pay using 1 dollar coins/bills, 5 dollar and 10 dollar bills for an object that costs exactly "13 Dollars" without asking for change. Scoring: 3 or 4 correct ways = 3 pts; 2 ways = 2 pts; 1 way = 1 pt; 0 ways = 0 pts.
Number of correct combinations for 13 Dollars
Practice (not scored): "To which category do an orange and a banana belong?" (Fruit). Administer the 3 scored pairs below (one prompt permitted per item if first response is concrete).
train - boat (acceptable: means of transportation, travelling, vehicles; NOT iron/engines/fuel)
north - south (acceptable: cardinal directions, cardinal points, directions, hemispheres, regions)
drum - flute (acceptable: musical instruments; NOT wood/sound)
1 point is allocated ONLY for words recalled with No cue (free recall). Category cue and multiple-choice cue responses are recorded for clinical info (0 points).
ROSE - Recall with No cue (1 pt if Yes)
ROSE - Multiple choice cue (rose / daisy / tulip)
CHAIR - Recall with No cue (1 pt if Yes)
CHAIR - Multiple choice cue (table / chair / bed)
HAND - Recall with No cue (1 pt if Yes)
HAND - Multiple choice cue (foot / hand / knee)
BLUE - Recall with No cue (1 pt if Yes)
BLUE - Multiple choice cue (blue / brown / red)
SPOON - Recall with No cue (1 pt if Yes)
SPOON - Multiple choice cue (fork / spoon / knife)
Identify as many superimposed drawings as possible within 60 seconds (do not rotate picture). Scoring: 9-10 objects = 3 pts; 6-8 = 2 pts; 4-5 = 1 pt; 0-3 = 0 pts.
Point to each animal and say: "Tell me the name of this animal." 1 point awarded per exact animal.

White background: Ask subject to read out loud numbers in the CIRCLES only (do not read squares or triangles). Error = wrong shape, omission, or incorrect order. Scoring: <=1 error = 1 pt; >=2 errors = 0 pts.
White background - Number of errors (<=1 error = 1 pt; >=2 = 0 pts)
Black background: Ask subject to read out loud numbers in the CIRCLES and SQUARES across both rows (do not read triangles). Scoring: <=2 errors = 2 pts; 3 errors = 1 pt; >=4 errors = 0 pts.
Black background - Number of errors (<=2 = 2 pts; 3 = 1 pt; >=4 = 0 pts)
Upload the completed paper MoCA-B sheet (photo or PDF).
